# MinuteHand

MinuteHand (https://minutehand.ca) is an AI-powered meeting minutes generator for strata councils, homeowners associations (HOAs), and nonprofit boards. It also offers a full governance records suite for boards that need year-round recordkeeping beyond individual meetings.

## What it does

MinuteHand converts rough meeting notes, Microsoft Word documents (.docx), or audio recordings (.mp3, .m4a, .wav) into professionally formatted meeting minutes. Audio recordings are automatically transcribed with speaker diarization (individual speaker identification). Users can confirm speaker names before minutes are generated. Finished minutes are exported as .docx files.

## Who it is for

Volunteer secretaries and board members responsible for meeting minutes without administrative support. Primary users include:
- BC strata council secretaries
- Homeowners association (HOA) board secretaries
- Nonprofit board secretaries and administrators

## Pricing

### Pay-per-use
No subscription required. Credits never expire.
- 1 meeting credit: $7 CAD
- 5 meeting credits: $20 CAD (approximately $4 per meeting)

### Board Plan — $75 CAD/year
The Board Plan is a yearly subscription that unlocks the full Governance Records suite, plus 12 meeting credits per year (enough for monthly meetings). Additional credits can be purchased at pay-per-use rates if needed. Includes a 30-day full refund — no questions asked.

Board Plan features:
- 12 meeting credits included per year
- Motion and decision registry — every motion searchable across all meetings
- Cross-meeting action item tracking with open/overdue status
- Auto-generated next-meeting agenda from open action items
- Full-text search across all meeting content
- Council roster with role history
- Special resolution vote calculator
- Governance document library with version history and archived versions
- Document templates: AGM Notice, SGM Notice, Written Resolution
- Owner-facing minutes portal — a secure per-organization link where strata owners can read and download published minutes without creating an account

## Key features (minutes generation)

- Accepts pasted notes, up to 5 .docx file uploads simultaneously, and audio recordings up to 50 MB
- Automatic transcription using Deepgram Nova-2 with speaker diarization
- Speaker name confirmation UI before minutes are generated
- Tip: ask participants to state their name at the start of recordings for best speaker identification
- Supports multiple meeting types: Strata Council (BC), HOA Board, Nonprofit Board, Team/Informal
- Exports finished minutes as .docx
- Sign in with email/password or Google
- Pay with PayPal — no Stripe account required

## Privacy

Meeting content is processed securely and not used to train AI models. Audio files are deleted immediately after transcription. No user data is sold or shared with third parties.
